notes.title: Paper Can't Fly is now available for wishlisting!
notes.content:
Hello Players!

For almost a year now, we've been working on a special new game called Paper Can't Fly, and we're finally ready to reveal it to everyone!

In Paper Can't Fly, you fly a paper plane through various levels, but you can also build and share your own levels with the world! The game's set out to release in October 2023, right after the conclusion of Steam's Next Fest during the same month.

We'd like to invite everyone to wishlist this game on Steam. It's free to do so, and will help us out a ton!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2106960/Paper_Cant_Fly

FLY!

Fly, Build & Share! Take control of a paper plane and soar through a variety of levels that will challenge your skills and reflexes. The gameplay is easy to pick up, but difficult to master - so get ready to put your skills to the test!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36992799/58cddbd25e0cec0dd26be5d629cee0b9aee0b986.gif

BUILD!

But the fun doesn't stop there! With the included level editor, you can unleash your creativity by building your own levels and experimenting with a wide variety of tiles and objects to design the ultimate paper plane challenge. The sky is the limit!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36992799/42b45b44d7d48355aa7e4f1d8a5763c66351472c.gif

SHARE!

And if that's not enough, you can also share your levels with the world! Challenge others to beat your creations or play community-made levels yourself. There's always something new to discover and conquer in this exciting and endlessly creative game!

Thank you, and enjoy!

notes.title: Update 1.1 now live on System Invaders!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We're pleased to announce that Update 1.1 is now live and available to play in System Invaders!

Special Promotion!

Because of this major update, we'd thought we'd give back to the community! Whoever purchases the game, and reviews it before the 24th of April 2020, gets another copy of the game soon afterward completely for free! Now let's go over what this update includes.

[previewyoutube=MlxTBSKk_Lw;full][/previewyoutube]

Features

 Added chapter 5 which includes the final boss called Destroyer.
 Added a weapon called orange that is slower but deals more damage.
 Added a ghost ability to Specter which lets it go invincible for a few seconds.
 Added hearts before boss encounters.
 Added Discord Rich Presence. Now your friends on discord can see what you're doing within System Invaders.
 Added tips to loading screens.
 Added global unlock percentages in the achievements.
 Added scroll bars to scrollable interfaces.
 Added Release Notes.


Changes

 Nerfed all bosses by reducing their health, reason being they were too difficult to destroy.
 Chapter 4 now has a higher amount of enemies.
 Pink weapon now has a slightly higher fire rate.
 Levels now display their names on the level selection menu.


Fixes

 Fixed music not playing in some levels.
 Fixed the ability to shoot weapons rapidly by spamming the shoot buttons.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1253110/System_Invaders/
